question: What is the centered moving average of the customs duty rate imposed on goods subject to duty from FY1939 - 1941 inclusive rounded to the nearest thousandths place?
raw_response:
Using the FY totals for duties/taxes and values of dutiable/taxable imports, the FY1939–FY1941 centered moving average rate is 37.708%.

<FINAL_ANSWER>37.708</FINAL_ANSWER>
